# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v6.7.0)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Zero runtime third-party dependencies. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v6.7.0 Capabilities
- **Polyglot Monorepo Auto-Discovery, Full-Stack CodeMap v5.1, Pinned Sidecar Graph Engine & Additive-Only Fail-Closed Diff-Impact v3.1 (`src/init/`, `src/codemap/`, `src/codemap/providers/`, `src/impact/`, ADR-0007)**: Automatically discovers nested depth-1 and depth-2 (`src|apps|packages|services|modules`) polyglot subprojects (Node/Vue 3/TS, Java, Go, Rust, Python `FastAPI`/`aiohttp`/`Flask`/`Starlette`/`Django`/`Pytest`, PHP) without colliding with single-repo boundaries, remaps shared-`.git` monorepo diffs cleanly, and fuses L0 zero-dep full-stack extractors (Vue 3 single-object router modules & lazy component bindings, balanced TS generics `<T>`, 2-arg `(method, url)` wrappers, `.cjs`, cross-file URL prefix helpers, Spring `WebProperties` prefix resolver, Feign/Dubbo/RocketMQ/XXL-Job/MyBatis XML/`BaseMapper<DO>`, Python `FastAPI`/`Flask`/`aiohttp`/`Starlette`/`Django` endpoints, SQLAlchemy/Django/DDL & TypeORM `@Entity` models) + L1 pinned `DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp@0.12.1` sidecar (with `AITEST_DATA_DIR` / `AITEST_CBM_*` data-dir migration, ephemeral tmpdir DB leak prevention, 6-platform SHA-256 verification, `--ui=false`, cross-platform short-path isolation, offline `--from-file`/`--mirror-url` installs & `N-1` rollback) + L2 anti-corruption fusion. Persists `pipe-sharded-v1` 16-shard `knowledge/graph-impact-index.json` loading in `<20ms`, narrows Python `.py` reverse imports and `.md`/`.txt` non-spec docs while enforcing `Global Infra Guard` & `>65` high-fan-in fail-closed sentinels, binds `scope.graphEngine` in `in-toto v1` attestations, and ships a live 8/8 conformance suite (`conformance/graph-engine/`).
- **8-Pillar Pinned MCP Hub, Targetless `engine-status` & Hardened Governance Lock (`src/mcp-hub/`, `src/kernel/gate/policy.mjs`)**: Upgrades MCP Hub to 8 pillars (adding `code-intelligence` with `codebase-memory-mcp@0.12.1`), seals `.aitest/mcp.lock` and `.aitest/engine-manifest.json` inside `.aitest/governance.lock`, supports global targetless/uninitialized `mcp engine-status` plus structured `USAGE_ERROR` / `WORKSPACE_NOT_INITIALIZED` recovery envelopes across `mcp`, `map`, and `impact`, enforces local binary SHA-256 and native sidecar safety in `mcp doctor`, and supports `upgrade --scope engines` without auto-resigning locks.
- **Authoritative 4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel (`src/kernel/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/kernel/gate/rules/`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Pluggable **18 rules `AITEST-G101..G118`** (SymbolTable v2.1, scoped `AITEST-G110` conservation, governance-locked `customMatchers` & declarative `qa/support/project-rules.json`, `AITEST-G116` HTTP status equivalence, `AITEST-G117` Dieselgate guard, `AITEST-G118` cross-directory lockstep sync gate), fail-closed sticky-T1 `.aitest/governance.lock`, signed `.aitest/baseline-ref`, and ULID `Run Ledger` binding (`FGER-internal = 0.0%`, `FGER-holdout = 0.0%`, `FGER-agentic_T2 = 0.0% (0/22)`, frozen `v6.0` blind unseen holdout FPR `6.1% (3/49)`, 100-commit regression corpus FPR `4.1% (4/97)`).
- **Dual-Target 5-Checkpoint Differential Parity Oracle & Zero-Plaintext Shape Fingerprints (`src/kernel/diff-oracle.mjs`, `src/parity/`, `src/corpus/`, `src/replay/`, `src/diagnose/`)**: `aitest_parity` & `verify-change --mode parity` compare Baseline vs Candidate across `CP1..CP5` with auth context injection, `AUTH_OR_SHELL_INVALID` fail-closed guards, zero-dep Anthropic/OpenAI SSE reassembly, `--privacy-mode shape-only` `fp_<12hex>` clustering, `serviceChains` + `tenantAuthHints` diagnostics, offline sanitized corpus, sealed external upstream replay cassettes, and streaming SSE `TTFT` SLO gates.
- **Toolified Memory Loop, Known Blockers & Human Seam Gatekeeper Card (`src/memory/`, `src/learn.mjs`, `src/verdict/seam-card.mjs`)**: Governance-locked `qa/known-blockers.json` blocks duplicate heal sessions; `aitw learn --action distill|sweep` emits staging-only proposals (`learn-proposals.{json,md}`) and sweeps latent anti-patterns repo-wide; `aitest_report(view="lessons")` exposes read-only distilled memory; `verdict-summary.md` attaches the **Human Seam Gatekeeper Card** (`seamReview`).
- **Zero-Dep Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server (`src/mcp/`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: MCP `2024-11-05`..`2025-11-25` with **17 canonical typed tools**, `aitest://project/{target}/graph-summary` resource, in-process read-only fast paths, subprocess job isolation (`syncBudgetMs`), and linear-time ReDoS-hardened redaction (`src/core/redact.mjs`).
